title: Flow Library: a refused licence gate is a silent no-op
description: Split out of MPI-666, the half of its title it never fixed. downloadService.start() resolves undefined both when the user refuses MpiLicenceGate and when the install succeeds, so MpiFlowLibrary._installMissing() cannot tell them apart and the tile silently falls back to Install after a Cancel or a failed verify probe. Proposed shape: start() returns false on refusal (every other caller awaits and discards the result) and _installMissing reacts to it. Was blocked on MPI-500 owning downloadService.js; MPI-500 is done. Open product call: whether a deliberate Cancel needs a message now that the chip and drawer licence links exist.
